title: The project garden gets six new entries
summary:
A community roll call: six more projects showing pollinations growing through art tools, bots, WordPress, mobile, and audio.

The community project lists now feature Elixpo Art, LAHGen, the AlphaLLM Discord bot, a WordPress AI Vision Block, a Flutter/Dart SDK, and Podcast #1500. Images, chat, WordPress, mobile, and a podcast: the usual tidy definition of "API user" continues to fail.
